voice_description: Role: supernatural female ghost with a distinctly non-living, shaped animated voice. Gender: female. Apparent age: around thirty. Persistent vocal posture: extremely light breath-supported phonation with minimal chest involvement, as though the voice barely has a physical body producing it. Pitch: high soft soprano with slow floating movement and occasional strange downward slips. Resonance: primarily airy head resonance with very weak chest resonance and a thin hollow quality. Timbre: pale, breathy, glassy, fragile, wispy, distant and cold. Phonation: incomplete vocal closure producing significant breath noise around a delicate voiced core. Breathing: unusually soft drawn-out inhalations and fading breath after phrases. Articulation: smooth softened consonants, long fading vowels and slightly blurred phrase endings. Prosody: suspended timing, unnatural pauses and lingering endings that seem reluctant to stop. Personality: sorrowful, gentle, mysterious and detached from ordinary time. Important: she should sound physically insubstantial and supernatural even when speaking normally. Avoid merely producing a quiet elegant woman.
direction: Speak softly with lingering breath and unnaturally suspended timing. Let one phrase fade nearly into breath before recovering into speech. Do not use a full whisper; preserve enough vocal tone to establish a cloneable identity.

text: You... can see me, can't you? It has been so many years since anyone looked directly at this window. Please don't be afraid. I have waited here only because there was something... something I promised I would never leave behind.
